title: DeckPilot plugin registry: keys/<n>.json
description: Design artifact (docs/marketplace/architecture.md section 9). One link of the key-set chain. keys/<n>.json.minisig is a JSON array of minisign signatures (base64, Tauri format) with the trusted comment 'deckpilot-registry v1 role:keys version:<n>'. It carries a threshold of signatures from the root role of version n-1 (the embedded roots for n = 1) and, when the root role changes, also a threshold from the new root role.

seq_floor.description: Lowest seq a client accepts for documents signed under this key set.

seq_floor_reset.description: Recovery from an index-key compromise that inflated seq: clients replace their stored seq with seq_floor.

items.description: Base64-wrapped minisign public key, the format DECKPILOT_UPDATER_PUBKEY uses.
